summary: The customer called angrily because her power was scheduled for shut off due to a past-due bill, and she was denied an automated payment extension. The agent explained the company policy limiting extensions to one per year and offered alternative plans requiring a partial payment, which the customer rejected because she had no money. After refusing the agent's proposed solutions and insulting the agent, the customer demanded a supervisor transfer, and the agent initiated the transfer.

evidence.text: I am initiating the transfer to my supervisor, Ms. Davis. Please stay on the line and the next available manager will be with you shortly.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Transfer the customer to a supervisor.

evidence.text: I understand you are frustrated, and I apologize for the stress this has caused. Let me look into your account right away. May I please have your account number or the phone number associated with the account?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a calm, polite, and professional demeanor throughout the call despite the customer being hostile and insulting.

evidence.text: I completely sympathize with your situation, and unexpected medical expenses are certainly difficult.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent actively acknowledged and validated the customer's difficult personal and medical situation multiple times.

evidence.text: I am initiating the transfer to my supervisor, Ms. Davis. Please stay on the line and the next available manager will be with you shortly.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The issue was not resolved on the line due to system constraints, but the agent successfully handled the escalation request by initiating a supervisor transfer.

evidence.text: The challenge is that our disconnection schedule is set by regional operations, and once a notice reaches this final stage, the system automatically locks out further extensions without a partial payment.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained policies, system limitations, and requirements clearly and understandably.

evidence.text: I am initiating the transfer to my supervisor, Ms. Davis. Please stay on the line and the next available manager will be with you shortly.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly set expectations for the transfer and closed the interaction professionally, though it was an escalation rather than a final resolution.

evidence.text: Our system policy allows for one payment extension per calendar year, Ms. Davis, which is why the automated system blocked your request.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent provided accurate information regarding company policy and system limitations regarding payment extensions.

evidence.text: If you can make even a small good-faith payment today—say, twenty-five percent of the balance—I can manually extend the remaining balance for those two weeks.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent strictly adhered to company policies regarding payment extensions and escalation procedures.

quote.text: I am absolutely furious, that's how I am. I just got a notification that my power is scheduled to be shut off tomorrow morning, and I want to know why nobody warned me properly!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: My power cannot be shut off. I’ve been a customer for ten years and this is how you treat people?
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Policy? I don't care about your ridiculous policies! People have emergencies! I had unexpected medical bills, and I simply don't have the full amount right now to pay this bill today!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Then transfer me! Maybe your manager actually has some common sense and empathy instead of just reading off a computer screen like a robot!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: I don't have twenty-five percent! I have zero dollars until the fifteenth! How many times do I have to spell that out for you? Do you speak English?
